verses.html: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.title: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.html: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.html: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.html: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.html: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.html: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.text: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.html: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.text: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

verses.html: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.text: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.html: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

verses.html: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.text: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.html: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.html: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.text: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

verses.html: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
verses.text: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

verses.html: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.text: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.html: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
verses.text: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

verses.html: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.html: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.text: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

verses.html: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
verses.text: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

verses.html: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

verses.html: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.text: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

verses.html: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.html: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.text: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
